intro.title: 7 Mukhi Rudraksha Bracelets
intro.description: Collection of bracelets made using original 7 Rudraksha from Java in silk thread, silver and stretch elastic. We are a trusted brand since 1997 supplying natural, finest quality and genuine Rudraksha beads. These stylish bracelets methodically handcrafted as per our unique methodology by skilled artisans can be worn regularly as per our therapy to derive optimum results. The 7 mukhi Rudraksha bead is associated with Goddess Laxmi and planet Venus. The Rudraksha blesses the wearer with materialistic comforts, name, fame, luck, love and abundance and attracts opportunities.
